name: Bathroom Cleaning Checklist
description: A step-by-step bathroom cleaning checklist for the toilet, shower, tiles, mirror, and fixtures.

items.text: Remove rugs, towels, and clutter from surfaces and the floor
Spray the toilet bowl with cleaner and let it sit
Spray the shower, tub, and tiles with cleaner to dwell
items.note: Letting cleaner sit for five minutes dissolves soap scum so you scrub less.

items.text: Open a window or run the exhaust fan for ventilation
Empty the bathroom trash and add a fresh liner
Clean the mirror until it is streak-free
Wipe down and disinfect the vanity countertop
Scrub the sink basin and clear the drain
Polish the faucet and handles
Wipe down cabinet fronts and organize toiletries
Scrub the inside of the bowl, including under the rim
Disinfect the seat, lid, and hinges
Wipe down the tank, handle, and exterior
Clean the base and the floor immediately around the toilet
Replace the toilet paper and refill any holders
Scrub the shower walls, tub, and basin
Clean the glass door or wash the shower curtain and liner
Scrub grout lines and treat any mildew spots
Descale the showerhead and faucet of mineral buildup
Clear the drain of hair and debris
Wipe down ledges, shelves, and shampoo caddies
Wipe down towel bars, hooks, and the toilet paper holder
Clean light fixtures and switch plates
Wipe the exhaust fan cover and clear visible dust
Polish chrome and metal fixtures to a shine
Wipe down the door, handle, and frame
Sweep or vacuum hair and dust from the floor
Mop the floor, getting into corners and around the toilet base
Wash bath mats and hang fresh towels
Refill hand soap and replace empty supplies
Do a final wipe and inspection of all surfaces

faq.q: What order should I clean my bathroom in?
faq.a: Spray the toilet, shower, and tub first so the cleaner can work, then clean the mirror and sink while it dwells. Scrub the toilet and shower, and finish with the floor.

faq.q: How often should I clean my bathroom?
faq.a: Wipe the sink and counter daily and do a full clean weekly. Deep tasks like scrubbing grout, descaling fixtures, and washing the shower curtain are best done monthly.

faq.q: How do I remove soap scum from shower tiles?
faq.a: Spray the tiles with a bathroom cleaner or vinegar solution, let it sit for several minutes, then scrub with a stiff brush. Rinse and wipe dry to prevent new buildup.

faq.q: How do I keep my bathroom mold-free?
faq.a: Run the exhaust fan during and after showers, wipe down wet surfaces, and treat early mildew spots quickly. Re-caulk cracked seals where mold tends to start.

faq.q: Can I download this bathroom cleaning checklist?
faq.a: Yes. Print it or save the PDF and tick off each task for a quick weekly clean or a deeper scrub.
